gen-luckiest-guy-gf-aclonica: Loud, poured-ink letters up top, all one width. Aclonica holds the text below with a deep lowercase and widely spaced sans-serif letters, so a longer stretch stretches out and slows down.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Cheerful and shouting, with ink poured at one width. Noto Sans Deseret is the sans-serif that keeps things friendly below it, its open shapes and wide, squat lowercase being what the pair does best.
gen-megrim-fs-ranade: Megrim draws thin, angular letters with matching stroke ends. Ranade follows in a sans with a slight swell on its curves and widely spaced letters, so a longer passage drifts along softly.
gen-megrim-montserrat: Montserrat glides along with oversized, open curves under Megrim's angular heading. Pick a text size a bit generous, since that spacious white space around each curve is what makes the sans look good.
gen-metal-mania-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Heavy, spiky and a little menacing. Be Vietnam Pro sits beside it as a sans-serif with curve endings kept well apart, so the two feel like a growl followed by a clear voice.
gen-metal-mania-fs-karma: Karma reads like a classic serif, with a mellow thick-thin shift and terminals clear of the stem. Metal Mania then stomps over it in one constant line width, which gives the page a loud head and a quiet body.
gen-metal-mania-rubik: Metal Mania has huge, open eyes on every e and a heavy, flat look. Rubik is a soft sans-serif with big lowercase letters, and its open round shapes are the best thing about the pair.
gen-modak-fs-erode: Playful, with fat strokes that never thin. Erode takes over below as a serif with a tall middle band and curves that thin out gently, and that dignified calm is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-nixie-one-gf-actor: Thin, retro and stitched-looking. Actor sits below it as a plain sans with wide s curves barely curled in, so the headline feels like old tech and the text feels fresh.
gen-nixie-one-zilla-slab: Nostalgic, thread-thin lines with open curves and no pressure variation mark Nixie One as the heading. Zilla Slab adds sturdy slab-serif weight beneath it.
